study type: descriptive and analytic study using a prospective and target analysis
cohort: Women who gave birth in General hospital 'Prim.dr A.Nakaš' in 2007 (control group) and 2017 (investigation group)
finding: The study found an increase in the Cesarean section rate from 15.5% in 2007 to 22.9% in 2017 in a hospital in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
